name: Tiangong
summary: Tiangong is the first humanoid from the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center, shown in 2024 as a 1.63 m, 43 kg all-electric robot able to jog at 6 km/h. It is meant as an open base platform for embodied AI research and was followed by faster versions such as Tiangong Ultra.
sensors: 3D vision sensors, six-axis force sensors and IMUs.
highlights: Billed as the first full-size humanoid able to run on electric drive only.
Handles slopes and stairs without relying on vision ('blind' walking).
caveats: The 'world's first' claim is the developer's own.
Specs differ between later Tiangong versions.

sources.title: China's home-grown general-purpose humanoid jogs out at 6 km/h
